name: Youth Entrepreneurship Resource Hub
slogan: Empower young people to become entrepreneurs

/careers.title: Build the future of youth enterprise with us.
/careers.description: Whether you represent an institution, partner organization, experienced mentor, or impact investor, discover how you can shape young entrepreneurs across Kenya.

sections.title: Why collaborate with YERH
sections.body: YERH connects verified institutions, ecosystem partners, seasoned mentors, and catalytic capital directly with youth founders ready to build resilient, market-tested ventures.

sections.title: Clear pathways and direct review
sections.body: Every institutional onboarding request and career collaboration application is reviewed directly by our platform administrators so you receive a tailored, accountable response.

/careers/institutions.title: Onboard your high school, university, or innovation hub.
/careers/institutions.description: Bring structured entrepreneurship learning, verified student affiliation, cohort tracking, and Moodle classroom integration to your campus or hub.

sections.title: High Schools: Practical Enterprise & Facilitator Tools
sections.body: Equip entrepreneurship clubs and business studies classes with structured venture teams, cohort milestone tracking, Moodle Teaching & Grading Guides, and verified YERH certificates.

sections.title: Universities: Seamless Campus Verification & Incubation
sections.body: Onboard student founders automatically via official university email domains, monitor student ventures from an institutional portal, and connect teams with external YERH mentors.

sections.title: Innovation Hubs: Cohort Oversight & Demo Readiness
sections.body: Manage incubated founders across multiple cohorts, track marketplace product approvals, verify fees cleanly, and showcase hub enterprises across the national ecosystem.

/careers/partnerships.title: Partner with YERH to accelerate young founders.
/careers/partnerships.description: Co-host transformative events, sponsor ecosystem programmes, propose training themes, and connect directly with emerging youth-led enterprises.

sections.title: Host Events, Clinics & Bootcamps
sections.body: Approved partners receive a dedicated Partner Dashboard to organize virtual or physical events, manage presenter lineups, and view verified attendee registrations.

sections.title: Propose Training & Ecosystem Initiatives
sections.body: Submit course proposals to our platform administrators, sponsor cohort challenges, and bridge market access gaps alongside Kenya's youth enterprise community.

sections.title: Visibility Across the Hub
sections.body: Partner organizations are featured across our live homepage partner strip, event catalogues, and institutional outreach channels.

/careers/mentorship.title: Guide the next generation of Kenyan founders.
/careers/mentorship.description: Share your operational wisdom, coach incubated ventures through structured stages, and build measurable entrepreneurial capability.

sections.title: Structured Venture Coaching & Moodle Access
sections.body: Receive assigned ventures across high schools, universities, and hubs inside a single unified Mentor Dashboard and synced Moodle classroom.

sections.title: Assess Incubation Stages & Propose Courses
sections.body: Review student milestones, grade structured venture stages, answer questions in public forums as a recognized Mentor, and propose specialized courses to earn royalties.

sections.title: Measurable Impact & Community Leadership
sections.body: Track active and graduated ventures you have guided while building standing on the YERH Mentor Leaderboard.

/careers/invest.title: Back vetted, incubation-ready youth enterprises.
/careers/invest.description: Partner with YERH to discover high-potential ventures completing structured milestones, market testing, and compliance readiness.

sections.title: Pipeline of Incubation-Vetted Founders
sections.body: Access young entrepreneurs who have progressed through validated business planning, mentor grading, and real customer engagement on the YERH Shop.

sections.title: Co-Design Grants, Fellowships & Capital Vehicles
sections.body: Launch targeted funding challenges, seed prizes, or impact investment showcases supported by transparent cohort metrics and milestone verification.

sections.title: Trusted Institutional Governance
sections.body: Every venture, institution, and transaction on YERH is audited and overseen by platform administrators for transparency and long-term impact.

/opportunities.title: Your next opportunity starts here.
/opportunities.description: Discover funding, market access and practical support for your venture.

/events.title: Connect. Learn. Put ideas into action.
/events.description: Explore upcoming sessions, meet their hosts and reserve your place.

/about.title: Ideas grow when people connect.
/about.description: A resource hub for young entrepreneurs and the people supporting them.
